Name: Gem Bushes
Author: EnbyFelix
Description: Adds bushes that give you gems during winter. They appear in the backwoods and mountain area. All of the gems are able to be found, including the prismatic shard, although the prismatic shard bush is much more rare.

Downloads.Description: Adds gems to bushes in winter in the backwoods and mountains.

Manifest.Description: Gems grow on bushes in the mountains and backwoods during winter.
